product_family: Trint AI transcription platform (transcription, live transcription, AI translation/summarization, collaboration, API/integrations)

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: We are ISO 27001 and Cyber Essentials certified, while all data within Trint is encrypted in transit and at rest.

certifications.name: Cyber Essentials
certifications.proof_quote: We are ISO 27001 and Cyber Essentials certified, while all data within Trint is encrypted in transit and at rest.

certifications.name: SOC 2
certifications.proof_quote: Not claimed anywhere on Trint's security page, support hub, or privacy/terms documents. No SOC 2 report or attestation found on the vendor's own domain.

certifications.name: PCI-DSS (payments, via processor)
certifications.proof_quote: Transactions are processed through a PCI-DSS-certified third-party payment processor, Stripe, which uses high-level encryption to protect all payment details entered.

privacy.ai_training_note: Trint explicitly states it does not train its models on customer content. Security page: 'unlike other AI transcription solutions, we never listen to your recordings to train our algorithms. In short, no one sees your data but you.' Homepage: 'We never train our algorithms on your transcripts and won't add a chatbot to your meeting either.' A separate Platform Privacy Policy (https://trint.com/docs/platform-privacy-policy) governs the SaaS platform; the website/marketing privacy policy explicitly does not cover platform data. Trint acts as data processor for customer content; the Enterprise Services Agreement covers the DPA terms.
privacy.data_region: Customer choice of EU or US. Data hosted in AWS data centers in both EU and US. Default retention is for the lifetime of the subscription; secure deletion available at contract termination or once per month on request.

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: HTTPS using TLS 1.2 for upload, export and transfer

security.name: Penetration testing
security.value: Yes - 'database back ups and penetration testing' cited as part of continuity/recovery plan

security.name: Bug bounty program
security.value: None found (no HackerOne or Bugcrowd program disclosed on vendor domain)

security.name: Employee access controls / MFA
security.value: MFA enforced for all employees; 'Trint employees never look at user data without your permission'

security.name: Hosting
security.value: Amazon Web Services (AWS), EU and US regions; serverless / infrastructure-as-code

security.name: Access control / SSO
security.value: SAML SSO and SCIM integration available (granular user permissions)

security.name: GDPR posture
security.value: States 'Trint is fully GDPR compliant'; UK-based controller with appointed EU representative (IT Governance Europe Ltd)

products.name: Trint Platform (SaaS transcription & content editor)
products.data_scope: Customer-uploaded audio/video transcripts; processed as data processor; EU or US residency on AWS; not used to train models
products.notes: Core product. 40+ language transcription, 70+ language translation, AI assistant for summaries/quotes. Governed by Platform Privacy Policy.

products.name: Trint Live
products.data_scope: Live audio/screen capture transcribed and shared in real time with team
products.notes: Same security posture as core platform.

products.name: Mobile & Desktop apps
products.data_scope: Capture and edit transcripts; sync to platform account
products.notes: Documented in support hub (Trint apps section).

products.name: Enterprise / Business
products.data_scope: Adds SAML SSO, SCIM provisioning, DPA via Enterprise Services Agreement, EU/US data residency selection
products.notes: Sold via 'Speak to sales'; used by newsrooms (POLITICO, AFP, SF Chronicle), sports, law firms, education.

compare.pricing_model: Subscription SaaS (self-serve tiers plus enterprise 'Speak to sales' for 50+ users); no public free-forever tier confirmed in evidence

flags: No SOC 2 attestation claimed (normal for a UK-based ISO 27001-certified vendor; not a negative, but enterprise buyers may request it)
No public bug bounty program (HackerOne/Bugcrowd) found
Default data retention is for the lifetime of the subscription; deletion is on-request (monthly) rather than automatic - worth noting for sensitive/legal use cases
Two separate privacy policies: website/marketing vs Platform Privacy Policy - directory should link the Platform Privacy Policy for product data questions
